decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - No building shall be occupied unless the loading and unloading space, turning space and parking spaces have been provided within the curtilage of the site for that building in accordance with a scheme to be approved by the Local Planning Authority and such spaces respectively shall not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 3 - No building shall be occupied until landscaping has been completed within the curtilage of the site for that building in accordance with a scheme to be approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - No construction work, which increases the ambient L90 noise level at the boundary of the nearest occupied dwelling in accordance with BS 4142 including the operation of any plant and machinery shall take place on site except between the hours of 7:30am to 7:00pm on Monday to Friday and 7:30am to 4:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays or public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The Bollo lane entrance to the site shall be closed to all construction traffic (including that of operatives) during the construction period except during the hours of 8:00am to 6:00pm on Mondays to Fridays, and 9:00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays.

Condition : 6 - Condition 4 shall not operate so as to prevent loading and unloading of building materials but not excavated material between the hours of 7:00am to 7:30am and 7:00pm to 10:00pm on Monday to Friday and between the hours of 7:00am to 7:30am and 4:00pm to 5:00pm on Saturdays. No such loading or unloading shall take place in Sundays or public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 7 - Adequate space shall be made available within the site during construction for the parking of all vehicles using the site in connection with construction.
Condition : 8 - All temporary lighting used during construction shall not be such as to cause material detriment by way of glare to the amenities of residents living adjacent to the site.
description: Variation of condition A(x) opening hours of Bollo Lane entrance of planning permission 00248/D/P7 dated 14/01/1991 for a Business Park with associated landscaping, support facilities, associated car parking, highways, and improvements to public transport.
